question: I booked an Ottawa visit in mid-February and want to skate on the Rideau Canal. Can you guarantee the Skateway will be open because February is winter?
generated_answer:
While February is typically cold enough for the Rideau Canal Skateway to be open, the exact opening and closing dates depend on weather conditions. The National Capital Commission (NCC) usually makes the decision based on ice thickness and safety. It's best to check the NCC's website or contact them directly for the most up-to-date information on the Skateway's status for your visit. 

If you're planning to skate, consider visiting the NCC's website or following their social media accounts for real-time updates. The Skateway is usually open from late December to early March, but the exact dates can vary from year to year. 

Additionally, if the Skateway is not open, there are other skating options in Ottawa, such as the Lansdowne Park outdoor rink or the Canlan Ice Sports facilities. 

So while there's no guarantee, February is a good time to visit Ottawa for skating, and with some planning and flexibility, you should be able to enjoy the Rideau Canal Skateway or other skating options during your visit.

- [National Capital Commission (NCC) Events and Activities](https://www.ncc-ccn.gc.ca/places/rideau-canal-skateway/events)
- [Canlan Ice Sports Ottawa](https://www.canlan.com/locations/ottawa)
